title: Burning City Quarter
name: scene_burning_quarter
scene_summary: A wide cobbled city street on fire between burning houses, a toppled waggon spilling sacks across the stones, and a big open fountain square that the fire has not reached yet, the city gate closing the street at the south end.
render_details: Grey cobbles wet with spilled oil, charred timber and splintered planks, smashed carts, burst barrels, orange flame in the windows of the burning houses, thick black smoke, drifting embers, soot-blackened stone, clean water in a carved basin, heavy timber gates bound with iron

rooms.label: Stone House
rooms.description: The ground floor of a big stone house on the west side of the street, still standing and still whole, its floors strewn with overturned furniture and fallen plaster, firelight and thick smoke spilling in through its doorway from the burning street.

rooms.label: Burning Tenement
rooms.description: A tenement block on the north side of the street, well alight, its stair hall full of smoke and burning beams fallen right across its rooms.

rooms.label: Burnt-Out House
rooms.description: A house already burnt through on the north-east corner, its floors heaped with char and fallen timber, only the blackened walls still standing.

rooms.label: Fountain Square
rooms.description: A big open square of grey cobbles filling the whole east side, with the carved stone fountain standing at its centre still full of clean water and benches under clipped bushes standing loose about the square, and nothing on fire anywhere in it.

rooms.label: Burning Street
rooms.description: A wide open stretch of cobbled road running the length of the map between the houses, the stones clear and readable from edge to edge with only scattered burnt debris on them, a few patches of the cobbles themselves alight and spilled oil darkening the joints.

rooms.label: Burning Warehouse
rooms.description: A corner warehouse on the south side of the street, flames running across its floor between fallen shelves and spilled stock.

annotations.label: Toppled Waggon
annotations.description: A big four-wheeled waggon lying over on its side in the middle of the street, its load of sacks spilled out across the cobbles around it and a slick of dark oil spreading from underneath it

annotations.label: Stone Fountain
annotations.description: A carved stone fountain standing at the centre of the square, its octagonal basin full of clean clear water, the cobbles around it wet and completely free of fire

annotations.label: Burning Gallery
annotations.description: A ruined timber gallery bridging the gap between the Stone House and the Burning Tenement, well alight along its whole length, its boards burnt through in places and burning fragments fallen on the ground beneath it

annotations.label: City Gate
annotations.description: A pair of great timber city gates bound with iron closing the south end of the street, set in a short stone gatehouse wall that runs a few paces to either side of the gates and simply ends, one leaf standing part open

annotations.label: Fallen Beam
annotations.description: A massive burning timber beam fallen right across the street, blocking it from one side to the other, flame running along its whole length and the cobbles scorched black beneath it

annotations.label: Spilled Masonry
annotations.description: A heap of fallen masonry and charred timber spilled across the street where the wall of a building has come down, spread flat over the cobbles and still smoking

annotations.label: Burning Cobbles
annotations.description: A stretch of cobbles running with burning oil, low flame spread flat across the stones rather than rising from anything standing on them
